stories.headline: Caleb Williams Goes Down Hobbled, Bears Camp Holds Its Breath
stories.read: Pardner, the Bears' gunslinger pulled up lame with a hamstring strain scrambling against the Vikings and got carted to the tunnel. Early word says it might just be a Grade 1 strain, but until that MRI comes back clean, Tyson Bagent's saddled up as the fella under center in Chicago. If Williams sits even a week, every Bears pass-catcher's cut of the throws takes a hit riding a backup horse. Watch this one close before you lock your Sunday lineup.

stories.headline: Jayden Reed Hospitalized Overnight, Packers Receiving Room Shook
stories.read: Scary scene up in New York, folks. Reed got carted off on a spine board two plays into the Jets tussle with a neck injury and stayed overnight in the hospital, though word is he's got movement in his extremities and posted he's feeling better. That's a relief for the man first, but his roster spot's frozen till we know more, and it cracks the door wide open for Romeo Doubs and Matthew Golden to grab a bigger share of the haul in Green Bay. Keep both on your radar for the open range this week.

stories.headline: Puka Nacua Trending Wrong Direction, Rams' Gold Mine on Shaky Ground
stories.read: The Rams' best claim from last season is nursing a hip and groin issue that's reportedly gettin' worse, not better, and he's a game-time coin flip most weeks till it clears up. When your bell-cow receiver's laid up, somebody else has to haul the load, so keep an eye on Tutu Atwell and Davante Adams for a bigger cut of Stafford's throws. Don't bench Nacua outright, but don't marry your lineup to him either till the saloon gets a firmer read.
